title: Simultaneous trained survivor and companion crew
retained_base: Selected individual survivor and pet identities, proportions, face/fur/feathers and useful baseline competence are retained. This is an illustrative eligible team, not a new count cap or a package that grants basic attack/carry/job competence.

team_policy.latest_owner_requirement: Multiple pets and survivors can be active simultaneously.
team_policy.prior_staged_policy: WHOLE_GAME_COMPLETENESS.json CD04 proposes up to three expedition pets and two survivor escorts; separately assigned local survivors and useful reserve-pet jobs are not that escort cap.
team_policy.status: Prior staged policy retained for review; not newly ratified, not claimed integrated or measured. No new total-population cap or paid active slot is authored.
team_policy.illustrative_roster_availability: Dog/wolf/owl are an illustrative source-identity team only where all are legitimately unlocked and eligible. This render does not move their source unlocks into World 1.

stages.name: TRAINED WORK CREW
stages.baseline_limitation: The current actors already coordinate eligible work and attacks. The proposed purchase must improve measurable protection/handling/recovery beyond their substantial existing outfits and animal harness/bedroll/pouch rigs.
stages.appearance_change: Keep both survivor identities and add distinct practical working protection: the forester/repair worker has a blue armored apron/chest guard and secured tools; the logistics worker has a protected work vest with a real quick-release load fixture. Preserve the dog and wolf scarf/pack identity while adding obvious fitted segmented chest/flank protection and secure quick-release pack mounts. Owl intentionally replaces the bulky bedroll/pouch arrangement with a compact removable flight-load frame and light protective breast shell, retaining face/feathers and blue scarf identity while freeing wing roots and primaries.
stages.purchase_value: Training improves measurable operation/handling and safe role transitions within already allowed tasks. Dog protects the chosen worker, wolf follows an assigned eligible track/hunt, owl reports only visible threats while survivors carry out real producer and logistics jobs together.
stages.jobs: Survivors supply, operate, repair and collect through real reservations; dog escort/intercept, wolf track/hunt and owl scouting/aerial strike remain existing capabilities, now coordinated by authored training.
stages.input_processing_output: Real wood/planks/supply stock passes from worker cargo to a reserved destination; no cash or stock appears. Gear/training buys efficiency/protection/tactics, not logical inventory capacity, basic attack or basic job access.
stages.footprint_ports_clearance: Separate working positions and pet approach/perch spaces; hands/tools, animal mouths, legs, paws and wings remain free.
stages.tradeoff: Training/gear cost and injury/replacement risk; simultaneously assigned jobs require actual available work and cannot teleport cargo or bypass target restrictions.
requirements: Preserved survivor/pet source identity and rigs
Shared job and target reservations, visible intent and safe preemption
Free switching cannot heal, revive or reset cooldowns
Full tool/cargo/attack transition and foot/wing motion proof

stages.name: VETERAN RESPONSE CREW
stages.baseline_limitation: The trained team already has useful roles and coordination. Veteran equipment must add real finite protection and measurable handling/attack-recovery improvement without reselling basic competence.
stages.appearance_change: Same source identities with substantially developed working armor: mobile blue-and-hide torso/shoulder/forearm protection on humans, larger fitted protective chest/flank panels on dog and articulated agile panels on wolf, each with reachable release fittings and no obstructed legs/jaws. Owl uses a distinct fitted lightweight aerial work rig with a protective breast/dorsal shell and compact detachable load fixture; never a heavy saddle or wing armor. Retained scarf/fur/feather language makes every actor recognizable. The owl change is an intentional flight-clear modular replacement of its old pack, not a claim the old owl lacked gear.
stages.purchase_value: Authored higher protection and practiced operation/attack recovery support a coordinated guard-and-resupply response: one survivor repairs/supplies while the other performs an authorized guard/hunt task; dog intercepts a pursuer, wolf flanks an eligible hostile and owl warns or performs its valid aerial strike. Exact stat gains are pending.
stages.jobs: Player-assigned priorities, target engagement slots, cover/retreat and resumption preserve each actor’s actual task, health and cargo. No invented new basic ability is sold.
stages.input_processing_output: Survivor supply and repair consume real existing materials; animal attacks are natural bite/pounce/talon contacts, not human weapons. Mouth/talon retrieval cargo must be secured or set down before an incompatible attack.
stages.footprint_ports_clearance: Keep human joint motion and tool grips clear, animal mouths and paws clear, owl shoulders/primaries/talons unobstructed; heavier gear cannot silently require a larger inaccessible agent body.
stages.tradeoff: Paid training/equipment and damage upkeep; working guard exposure remains a real risk. Death still needs ordinary paid replacement, with preserved earned XP/skills and separately recoverable estate cargo.
requirements: Useful quantified benefits measured against baseline without fabricated values
Damage and protection calculations linked to visible equipment
U3 target/provocation and friendly identity rules
Multi-actor contact/crowding, recall, injury, death and paid replacement integration
Survivor and each pet full-cycle multi-angle motion plus real sound evidence

Exact selected female survivor identity; preserve face, hair, body scale and recognizable clothes under proposed job gear.

Exact owl face/feather/wing identity; aerial attack and scouting already exist, all flight feathers and talons clear.
Exact selected hand-crank saw for the trained crew use scene; do not invent a different machine.
Exact selected fence for the veteran repair/resupply use scene; avoid an unreferenced wall or weapon.
Current selected raw-resource/cash unit size; no invented resources in work scene.
Current selected processed resource identities and unit size, including bound planks; show only goods actually relevant to the scene.

acceptance_checks: Same two survivor and three pet identities visible in every relevant group view
Substantial but physically plausible gear change between stages
No identity replacement, extra actor or species morph
All animal attacks and survivor unlimited carrying remain baseline, not sold as new unlocks
Real role differentiation and simultaneous useful work/defense visible
No human animal weapons or blocked owl wings/talons
No false numeric cap, free replacement, magic healing or cargo multiplication
Static poses do not claim tested animation, target logic or runtime balance
Existing animal gear acknowledged; new visible protection/work fixtures materially differ and owl modular replacement remains flight-clear.
Each stage retains a full-resolution front/rear master plus one separate full-resolution teamwork scene; both files must pass before the stage is complete.
Master source lineage preserves all five exact actor identities; use-scene call uses the exact reviewed master plus actual work object and current02/04, four references total.
Use scene preserves exact master faces, anatomy, mutual scale and declared gear; no compressed composite or overwrite of the master.
historical_combined_prompt: Create a strong HAVENLINE World 1 authored upgrade proposal, matching supplied selected references in stylized rounded 3D craft, warm orange timber, deep blue steel, rounded gray hardware and soft sculpted snow. Meaningful new functional structures, no recolor/brackets-only upgrade. Clean navy studio background and large readable objects. Exactly TWO rows by THREE roomy columns. Each row is one coherent new stage shown in front/exterior three-quarter, true opposite rear/interior three-quarter, and a functional cutaway/detail of that same design. No level numbers, prices, stat multipliers or implementation claims. Short stage/view labels and footer AUTHORED UPGRADE PROPOSAL. HEADER HAVENLINE / SURVIVOR AND PET CREW. This board has EXACTLY the same FIVE source identities in both rows: the referenced male survivor, referenced female survivor, one referenced dog, one referenced gray wolf and one referenced owl. It illustrates simultaneous actors, not a final cap, free acquisition or newly unlocked basic attacks. TOP ROW label TRAINED WORK CREW. First panel: a large front-three-quarter group lineup with both complete survivors and all three complete pets. Give the survivors useful, distinct work kits: a fitted forester/repair apron with secured hand tools and a logistics/supply harness with protected vest. Dog has a sturdy padded chest/flank guard harness, wolf a light tracker harness, owl only a tiny fitted breast/dorsal harness clear of wings. Second panel: genuine rear-three-quarter view of that same crew/gear, all bodies readable and no swapped costumes. Third panel: one useful simultaneous work vignette, both survivors at separate actual existing-resource handoff/repair positions, dog beside its protected worker, wolf watching a reachable approach and owl naturally perched or flying with clear wings. BOTTOM ROW label VETERAN RESPONSE CREW. Same identities and same body scale but much more substantial fitted protection and purposeful work/defense gear: blue armored working vests/coats with rounded shoulder/forearm protection on humans, secured specialist tools and modest distinct packs; a more protective dog chest/flank guard, agile articulated wolf shoulder armor, and distinctly designed but extremely lightweight owl harness. Preserve all original faces, fur patterns, feather shapes and paws. First and second panels are matching front and genuine rear group views. Third panel: coordinated defensive response pose without enemies or injury gore: one survivor guarding with a believable secured hand tool, the other supplying/repairing a real object, dog poised to intercept, wolf in a natural flanking stance, owl with a believable open-wing warning/dive-ready pose. Natural animal attack anatomy only: no animal swords, guns, crossbows, human hands, boots, spiked muzzles or heavy flight-blocking owl armor. Human tools cannot pass through hands or bodies. All feet/paws and owl wings/talons must be fully visible and free. Keep source scale relationships; packs are presentation, not a capacity upgrade. No extra anonymous crew, clone of a species, halos or magic. Short captions FRONT / REAR / TEAMWORK. The only capability claim is authored training/protection/coordination beyond existing useful baseline; do not print numerical stats.
